Name: Owl Scarecrows for CP (TheBigJB Update)
Author: thebigjb
Description:
[left]I love the original Owl Scarecrows mod and I want to see it kept alive! 

This mod started because I made some small changes to the Alternative Texture version for my own use that allows me to use any owl texture for any scarecrow - normal, rare, or deluxe. (The original was limited and didn't support Deluxe Scarecrows because it wasn't updated.)

Then I started wondering if I could pull one off for Content Patcher & GMCM. So I made both versions! ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26193/]Click here [/url]﻿for the Alternative Textures version.)

[b]Content Patcher + GMCM

[/b][list]
[*]Use GMCM to choose what kind of owl you want to replace your scarecrows. All options available for all scarecrow types!
[*]Compatible with 1.6+
[*]Works with the latest version of CP and GMCM
[/list][/left]

[center][color=red][size=3][b]Original assets used with permission from[/b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/936]Ankokou[/url]﻿﻿﻿.[/size][/color][/center]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/205777536-1718915106.png[/img]
[b]
Installation:[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Download and install the following:
[list=1]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI﻿[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]
[/list][*]Download the mod file then unzip/extract it into your Stardew mods folder!
[*]Fire up the game and enjoy!
[/list]
[b]Usage: 
[/b]Select which owl from the menu you'd like to swap out for the scarecrow listed. Leave blank to keep SDV default.
